title: Layer-Wise Gate-Controlled Prompt Truncation in a Multimodal Chest X-Ray Classifier
abstract: arXiv:2609.06590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture of Prompt Experts (MoPE) adapts multimodal transformers through input-dependent prompt composition, while retaining a fixed prompt length. We investigate a layer-wise gating extension in a binary chest X-ray classification pilot study. The controller predicts a retention ratio for each sample, averages these ratios within a mini-batch, and uses the resulting integer length to truncate the static and mixed visual prompts. Retained mixed prompts are also scaled by the individual ratios. In one recorded run per configuration, the gated model reached a best validation accuracy of 0.8996, compared with 0.8969 for the fixed-length baseline; the corresponding final values were 0.8963 and 0.8802. The exported gate statistics imply a retained length of one at all recorded training points, relative to a configured maximum of six. translated_title: 多模态胸部X光分类器中的逐层门控提示截断
translated_abstract: 提示专家混合通过依赖于输入的提示组合来自适应多模态Transformer，同时保持固定的提示长度。我们在一项二分类胸部X光分类的试点研究中研究了一种逐层门控扩展方法。控制器为每个样本预测一个保留比例，在迷你批次内对这些比例取平均，并使用所得的整数长度来截断静态和混合视觉提示。保留的混合提示还会按各自的比例进行缩放。在每个配置的一次记录运行中，门控模型达到了0.8996的最佳验证准确率，而固定长度基线为0.8969；相应的最终值分别为0.8963和0.8802。导出的门控统计数据显示，在所有记录的训练点上，相对于配置的最大值6，保留长度均为1。这将完整的视觉序列从210个标记减少到200个标记，但没有直接的运行时间测量来确立……
tldr: 本研究在多模态胸部X光分类器中提出逐层门控机制，通过为每个样本动态预测保留比例来截断和缩放视觉提示，在略微提升验证准确率的同时将提示长度从最大6缩减至1，实现更精简的视觉提示序列。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a layer-wise gating mechanism in a multimodal chest X-ray classifier that dynamically predicts per-sample retention ratios to truncate and scale visual prompts, slightly improving validation accuracy while reducing the prompt length from a maximum of six to one, resulting in a more compact visual prompt sequence.
